counting_unit: A reported specification is counted once within one empirical family. Coefficients from the same multivariate fit are not separate specifications. Pretrend and pseudo-break fits are diagnostics. Permutation, randomisation and power-simulation fits are resampling refits and never inflate the reported-specification count.

legacy_families.note: Thirty-six primary and 108 robustness break specifications; each carries a pretrend slope and pseudo-break diagnostic, with six additional selection checks. Placebo-date refits are counted only as resampling. The family is retired because Merge placebos fire and no admissible control group remains.

legacy_families.note: Twelve V2 models remain after removing every v3 outcome that treated local virtual depth as deposited capital. Their shared artifact is provenance-stale until the exact-lag capital and reserve-reconciliation rerun, and their prior pool-only covariance is not the locked primary inference, so the family is withheld. Five joint Wald rows are derived tests, not additional fitted specifications.

legacy_families.estimator: pool-month OLS and linear probability models
legacy_families.inference: pool clustered with joint role Wald tests
legacy_families.note: The V3 role-sign, net-flow-sign and fee-to-LVR fits are retired. Their dollar LVR numerator collapses a tick-crossing day to one volume-weighted tick, and the provider TVL denominator failed the historical-balance audit. Any future V3 family starts from an event-replayed inventory that separately passes custody and LP-ownership reconciliation plus path-integrated LVR as new specifications.

legacy_families.inference: pool clustered with joint role Wald tests
legacy_families.note: Nine v3 fits are retired because constant-product-equivalent virtual reserves measure local depth, not invested capital: role differences in risk-adjusted return and APR; unconditional and conditional risk-adjusted returns; net APR; fee yield; degree; native-quoted centrality; and the centrality-by-role interaction.

legacy_families.estimator: cross-sectional OLS and grouped-time complementary-log-log panel
legacy_families.note: The 32 reported specifications comprise 29 OLS and three grouped-time hazard models. Ten thousand permutation fits and four thousand power-simulation fits are resampling only. The result supports the architectural possibility of forced vehicle use and does not identify the later stable rotation.

legacy_families.note: The superseded broad RQ battery was removed from the current tree. Git history retains the old generation. Its durable lesson is that exploratory fits cannot become authority after the quantity contract or matching design changes. The replacement liquidity-allocation design is registered as liquidity_capital_flow_predictability and has no admitted model run until its purpose-bound inputs release.
